topic: fix a toilet that rocks on the floor
core_question: How do I fix a toilet that wobbles or rocks when you sit on it? (secondary: How should I store leather shoes for months so they don't get damaged?)
answer_summary: Remove the toilet, scrape off the old wax ring, shim the base level against the floor flange with plastic shims, install a new wax ring, and reset and bolt down the toilet.; after the topic shift: Clean and condition the shoes, insert shoe trees to hold their shape and absorb moisture, then store them in breathable cloth/dust bags (not sealed plastic) in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
